title: Pine64 launch $50 smart speaker for Home Assistant tinkerers
summary: Pine64 has launched the PineVoice, an affordable $50 RISC-V-based smart speaker designed specifically for Home Assistant enthusiasts and DIY tinkerers, offering an open-source hardware alternative to mainstream smart speakers.
problem_solved: Provides an affordable, privacy-focused smart speaker option for home automation enthusiasts who want full control over their devices without relying on Big Tech ecosystems.
why_valuable: democratizes smart home technology with an open-source, $50 device that gives users complete control over their data and avoids vendor lock-in common with commercial smart speakers.
